caption: The drawing depicts a bust of a figure adorned with a headdress featuring several feathers in muted tones of blue, red, and gray, all arranged vertically. The figure wears a white turban wrapped around the head beneath the feathers. The skin tone is brown with visible patches that suggest weathering, and the eyes are rendered in a forward-facing gaze. The figure has blue earrings that hang down from the ears. Around the neck is a beaded necklace with alternating green, blue, and red beads and a large, light gray circular pendant at its center. The person is dressed in a draped, richly red garment that covers both shoulders and is gathered at the chest in deep folds and creases, with shading suggesting fabric texture. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or designs. Near the lower right corner, there is a signature in small, cursive script.
title: Wooden Indian Bust
